full_details: The almanac said no play. In the forenoon the house heard a bell begin to the south-east, faint, and then others. None of the four of you said what they were for. About noon a neighbour's journeyman came to the street door with an account of the morning. You did not go down. Alse was sent to say you were at your work. You were not. You tried all afternoon and could not settle to a line. At dusk, at the window, you said you had heard the bells, and that was all you would say you knew. You went no further than the table and back.
one_sentence: You stayed in, heard the bells at breakfast, and scratched out a start.
title: Heard the bells at breakfast
